false_negatives.evidence: Folder selected must be of type the database can read and that is “name”.kdb
false_negatives.rationale: No behaviour is stated when a non-.kdb file is selected; also 'Folder' is used where a database file is meant, which could be misread.

false_negatives.evidence: or else the previews one will be replace if selected
false_negatives.rationale: It is unclear what 'the previous one' and 'if selected' refer to (which database, selected by whom/for what).

false_negatives.evidence: All data related to the word must be shown
false_negatives.rationale: 'Related to the word' is unbounded: which fields are searched (title, URL, notes...) and match rules (substring, case) are not defined beyond one example.

false_negatives.evidence: Password field and repeat password field must be identical
false_negatives.rationale: The system response to a mismatch (error message, blocking save) is not stated.

false_negatives.evidence: the repeat password field must be Changed and be identical with password field
false_negatives.rationale: Restates KP-012/KP-013 (repeat field must be completed and identical) with no distinct behaviour.

false_negatives.evidence: Sequence’s length must not be more than a line (59 characters)
false_negatives.rationale: What happens when an Auto-Type sequence exceeds 59 characters (rejected, truncated, warning) is not stated.

false_negatives.evidence: File formats are not specialized password database formats
false_negatives.rationale: It is not stated which file formats (import/export? which ones?) the statement applies to.

false_negatives.evidence: File formats only specify
false_negatives.rationale: The file formats in scope are not identified.

false_negatives.evidence: Malicious requests
false_negatives.rationale: 'Malicious' is not defined; no criteria for detection are given.

false_negatives.evidence: necessary content
false_negatives.rationale: Which content is 'necessary' is not defined.

false_negatives.evidence: are considered
false_negatives.rationale: 'Considered' does not specify what the system must do with anticipated and unanticipated requests; not testable.

false_negatives.evidence: Malicious requests
false_negatives.rationale: 'Malicious' is undefined (same issue accepted for PE-007).

false_negatives.evidence: Malicious requests are identified and acted upon.
false_negatives.rationale: Near-restatement of PE-007; additionally 'acted upon' is weaker than 'rejected', leaving the intended action unclear.

false_negatives.evidence: Functional policies
false_negatives.rationale: Which policies are 'functional' is undefined; requirement is not verifiable.

false_negatives.evidence: Must use a SQL based database.
false_negatives.rationale: Restates GJ-003 (SQL based database).

false_negatives.evidence: Shall install online help for users
false_negatives.rationale: No subject: unclear whether the system or the developers install the online help.

false_negatives.evidence: Shall deliver Operations and Maintenance manual
false_negatives.rationale: No subject identifying who delivers the documentation.

false_negatives.evidence: email customer and vendor in less than 1 second
false_negatives.rationale: The triggering event for the email (order placed, shipped, etc.) and its starting point for the 1-second timing are not stated.

false_negatives.evidence: validate credit card in less than 2 seconds
false_negatives.rationale: No behaviour is defined when card validation fails or the validation service is unavailable.

false_negatives.evidence: periodic backups
false_negatives.rationale: Backup period/frequency is not given.

false_negatives.evidence: validate credit cards against fraud
false_negatives.rationale: No behaviour specified when a card is flagged as fraudulent or the validation service fails.

false_negatives.evidence: all sensitive information
false_negatives.rationale: Which information counts as 'sensitive' is not defined.

false_negatives.evidence: auto detect IP DOS attacks and block IP automatically
false_negatives.rationale: Detection criteria/threshold and block duration/unblocking are not specified.

false_negatives.evidence: detect consecutive failed login attempts
false_negatives.rationale: No number of attempts and no resulting action (lockout, alert, duration) is stated.

false_negatives.evidence: validate 'existing' credit card in system after each log in
false_negatives.rationale: Behaviour when the stored card is invalid or expired is not stated.

false_negatives.evidence: validate email address existence
false_negatives.rationale: Behaviour when the email address does not exist or cannot be verified is not stated.

false_negatives.evidence: interchangeable plugins
false_negatives.rationale: What plugins and what 'interchangeable' means are not defined.

false_negatives.evidence: extremely portable
false_negatives.rationale: 'Extremely portable' is unquantified.

false_negatives.evidence: weborder system
false_negatives.rationale: 'Weborder system' is a new name for the product called 'Web Store' elsewhere.

false_negatives.evidence: OS: Apache web server
false_negatives.rationale: Lists Apache web server as the OS, conflicting with GJ-002 which specifies Slackware Linux 2.6 as the OS and Apache as the web server.

false_negatives.evidence: lock a Member account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts
false_negatives.rationale: Specifies the lockout trigger but omits the lockout duration and unlock/error behavior.

false_negatives.evidence: validate item eligibility ... and issue the loan receipt
false_negatives.rationale: Omits error handling when the barcode is invalid or the item is ineligible for checkout.

false_negatives.evidence: borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously
false_negatives.rationale: Conflicts with SD-009, which limits active simultaneous loans to at most 5 items.

false_negatives.evidence: 21 calendar days
false_negatives.rationale: Conflicts with SD-010, which defines the standard loan duration as 14 calendar days.

false_negatives.evidence: self-register online ... and immediately check out physical books without Librarian ID verification
false_negatives.rationale: Directly contradicts SD-001, which requires in-person Librarian verification of a government-issued photo ID before account creation.
